differences.what: Woofer cones in A keep their surround, cone and dust-cap shading; in B they crush to near-black discs with no readable detail
Tinted caustic shadows in A project each colour onto the floor as a crisp, graphic signature; B's shadows are soft warm smears with only faint colour bleed
Horn throats in B refract into lumpy, melted-looking shapes (red, yellow, clear units); A's throats read as clean, symmetric forms
B's wider lens keystones the end units: they lean outward, grow larger and crowd the frame edges, so the eight stop matching; A keeps the row even with margin at both sides
B's warm graded backdrop and soft falloff look more like a real studio sweep; A's flat, even grey sweep and uniform fill look CG-flat
B shows the cabinets' side faces and glass edge thickness, giving the acrylic more depth and volume; A's near-frontal view flattens the boxes into elevations
